name: Karen Prell
bio: Karen Leigh Prell (born July 26, 1959) is an American puppeteer and animator. She is the performer of Red Fraggle in Fraggle Rock.

credits.title: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift
credits.overview: It's the holiday season in Fraggle Rock, and Wembley can't wait to spread cheer as the Spirit Captain. But when the festive spirit starts fading, Wembley sets out to discover what truly makes the season special.

credits.title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
credits.overview: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.

credits.title: Jerry Nelson: A Celebratory Birthday Animatic

credits.title: The Muppets Take The O2
credits.overview: The Muppets Take the O2 is a live stage show starring the Muppets performed at the O2 Arena in London in July 2018. The show is a follow-up to 2017's performance at the Hollywood Bowl, reprising many of the same acts.

credits.title: The Muppets
credits.overview: When Kermit the Frog and the Muppets learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his felt-faced brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a telethon show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.

credits.title: Journey Through the Labyrinth
credits.overview: A retrospective look back at Jim Henson's 1986 fantasy film 'Labyrinth'.

credits.title: The World of Jim Henson
credits.overview: In this episode of PBS' Great Performances, the history and legacy of puppeteer Jim Henson is explored, from his six-second commercial beginnings to a five-season run on ABC of The Muppet Show to several theatrically released films, including five Muppet movies, The Dark Crystal, and Labyrinth.

credits.title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
credits.overview: A retelling of the classic Dickens tale of Ebenezer Scrooge, miser extraordinaire. He is held accountable for his dastardly ways during nighttime visitations by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future.
roles: Daughter Mouse / Ghost of Christmas Past (performer) / Additional Muppet Performer (voice)

credits.title: Jim Henson's Memorial Service
credits.overview: Following Jim Henson's passing on May 16th 1990, two public memorial services were held. The first (featured here) was held in New York at Cathedral of St. John the Divine on May 21, 1990. The second service was held in London at St. Paul's Cathedral on July 2nd 1990.
